Your home’s next chapter starts with a rug.
A rug brings the whole room together. Start with these simple proportions.
Choose 8 × 10 ft or larger so the front legs of your sofa and chairs rest on the rug.
A 5 × 8 ft rug suits smaller bedrooms. Choose 8 × 10 ft for a generous border around a queen bed.
Allow approximately 60 cm beyond the table on every side so chairs remain on the rug when pulled out.
Leave a little floor visible on both sides of a runner. Measure door clearance before choosing a thick pile.
A little regular care keeps your rug beautiful for years.
Vacuum gently without a rotating brush. Rotate every few months for even wear and use a rug pad underneath.
Blot immediately with a clean, dry cloth. Avoid rubbing or soaking. For deep cleaning, consult a professional familiar with your rug’s fibre.
Light shedding and subtle variations are part of a handmade wool rug’s character. Keep jute rugs dry and away from damp areas.
